notes.title: The INFINITY update - New modes added!
notes.content:
We've just added 3 new modes!

* Endless - how long can you last? Starts chilled but gradually increases the challenge.

* Gauntlet - can you get from A-Z in one life? (Hard)

* Timed Gauntlet - can you get from A-Z in one life, with a time limit? (Very hard)


A colorblind option has also been added.
